checks.result: Static source confirms encode validates before serialization and rejects encoded output above 1,048,576 bytes; decode bounds input before JSONDecoder then validates the decoded scene.

Static source confirms schema versions outside 1...5 fail unsupportedVersion before domain validation. Accepted scenes are copied and only schemaVersion is advanced to 5, preserving IDs, positions, settings, and allowed legacy data.

v1 forbids non-nil light optics; v1-v2 forbid cameraLens; v1-v3 forbid previewSettings; v1-v4 forbid placementRoom and emitter rollDegrees. This prevents a version label from silently assigning newer known-field semantics to an older scene.

LightingScene and StudioLight use synthesized Codable with optional optics/lens/preview/room properties. Missing optional fields remain nil; validation does not materialize new defaults. Source comments define nil optics as legacy isotropic point source, nil lens as default 50 mm perspective, nil preview settings as diagnostic card defaults, and nil room as absent measurements. These align with the architecture migration contract.

Validation retains maximum twelve lights, finite bounded positions and light parameters, valid optional settings and unique light UUIDs. All accepted versions use those same checks before canonicalization.
